caveats: No public org chart exists for SUNY Potsdam; leadership compiled from the Office of the President page, inauguration materials, and recent potsdam.edu news articles.
Dean of Students and VP for Enrollment Management could not be verified from public sources.
A&S dean: Dr. Celeste Marie Gagnon per a recent announcement (joined July 6); an older alumni event page named Gretchen Galbraith as A&S dean — likely a predecessor, flagged as uncertain.
VP for Advancement: David Davin per the Sept 10, 2026 fundraising article; an older announcement named Sal Cania Jr. — superseded.

Programs list is from the 2022-2023 ARCHIVED catalog (the URL supplied serves the archived edition). The current catalog is 2025-2026; its Programs of Study page URL could not be determined without guessing. Nine programs in the archived list were recommended for discontinuance/deactivation per the Provost's Academic Affairs Updates and may no longer be offered.
Potsdam news index shows featured items only (no dates on index); a paginated dated listing exists (e.g. /news?page=7) but was not crawled for this baseline.

tuition.summary: 2026-2027 in-state undergraduate: tuition $7,070/yr; fees $1,698/yr (tuition+fees $8,768/yr). Housing $9,780/yr, meals $6,874/yr. Online UG: $3,535/semester tuition + $271 fees. Subject to change by SUNY Board of Trustees.
